QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#5/r6.claim: A poem says wealth is no source of honor, all honor belongs to the pious, and someone who knows God but gains no benefit from that knowledge is wretched.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#5/r6.anchor: وأنشدوا في ذلك: ما يصنع العبد بعز الغنى والعز كل العز للمتقي

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#5/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#5/r7.speaker: النبي ﷺ
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#5/r7.claim: Al-Ṭabarī transmits from Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd that an Anṣārī man defended marrying for religion and character after his wife’s lineage was criticized; the Prophet said Islam lifted low status and removed blame, now belonging only to jāhiliyya.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#5/r7.anchor: ذكر الطبري حدثني عمر بن محمد قال حدثنا عبيد بن إسحاق العطار

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r1.speaker: النبي ﷺ
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r1.claim: The Prophet says he hopes to be the most God-fearing and most knowledgeable about what to avoid; al-Qurṭubī concludes that this makes him the noblest of people before God.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r1.anchor:
وقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم:
" إني لأرجو أن أكون أخشاكم لله

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r2.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r2.claim: Ibn al-ʿArabī says this is the principle Mālik considered in marriage compatibility.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r2.anchor: قال ابن العربي: وهذا الذي لحظ مالك في الكفاءة في النكاح

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r3.speaker: مالك
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r3.claim: According to ʿAbd Allāh’s transmission from Mālik, a client may marry an Arab woman, based on this verse.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r3.anchor: روى عبد الله عن مالك: يتزوج المولى العربية

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r4.speaker: أبو حنيفة، الشافعي
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r4.claim: Abū Ḥanīfa and al-Shāfiʿī take lineage and wealth into account in marriage compatibility.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r4.anchor: وقال أبو حنيفة والشافعي: يراعي الحسب والمال

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r5.speaker: عائشة
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r5.claim: In a report in the Ṣaḥīḥ, ʿĀʾisha recounts that Abū Ḥudhayfa adopted Sālim and married him to his niece Hind bint al-Walīd; Sālim was a client of an Anṣārī woman.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r5.anchor: وفي الصحيح عن عائشة أن أبا حذيفة بن عتبة بن ربيعة

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r6.claim: Further examples are Ḍubāʿa bint al-Zubayr married to al-Miqdād, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf’s sister to Bilāl, and Zaynab bint Jaḥsh to Zayd ibn Ḥāritha.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r6.anchor: وضباعة بنت الزبير كانت تحت المقداد بن الأسود

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r7.claim: These examples establish that clients may marry Arab women and that compatibility is based on religion.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r7.anchor: فدل على جواز نكاح الموالي العربية، وإنما تراعى الكفاءة في الدين

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r8.speaker: النبي ﷺ
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r8.claim: In Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Sahl ibn Saʿd reports the Prophet asking about a well-regarded man and then a poor Muslim; people deem the latter unsuitable, but the Prophet says he is better than the whole earth filled with the first man’s like.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r8.anchor: والدليل عليه أيضا ما روى سهل بن سعد في صحيح البخاري

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r9.speaker: النبي ﷺ
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r9.claim: The Prophet says a woman is married for wealth, beauty, religion, and in a variant lineage, then advises choosing the religious woman.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r9.anchor:
وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم:
" تنكح المرأة لمالها وجمالها ودينها

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r10.claim: Salmān proposed to Abū Bakr’s daughter and was accepted; ʿUmar declined his proposal, and when ʿUmar later asked Salmān to marry her, Salmān refused.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r10.anchor: وقد خطب سلمان إلى أبي بكر ابنته فأجابه

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r11.speaker: النبي ﷺ
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r11.claim: When Banū al-Bukayr refused Bilāl’s proposal, he complained to the Prophet, who became angry on his behalf; the brothers then married their sister to him.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r11.anchor: وخطب بلال بنت البكير فأبى إخوتها، فقال بلال: يا رسول الله، ماذا لقيت

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r12.speaker: النبي ﷺ
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r12.claim: Al-Qurṭubī introduces the Prophet’s statement about Abū Hind, who cupped him; the quotation continues in the next segment.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#6/r12.anchor: وقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في أبي هند حين حجمه

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r1.speaker: النبي ﷺ
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r1.claim: The Prophet urged people to marry Abū Hind and marry into his family; Abū Hind was a client of Banū Bayāḍa.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r1.anchor: " أنكحوا أبا هند وأنكحوا إليه " وهو مولى بني بياضة

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r2.speaker: النبي ﷺ
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r2.claim: Al-Dāraquṭnī reports from ʿĀʾisha that Abū Hind, who cupped the Prophet, was praised as someone whose heart God had filled with faith, followed by the Prophet’s marriage encouragement.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r2.anchor: وروى الدارقطني من حديث الزهري عن عروة عن عائشة أن أبا هند مولى بني بياضة

QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r3.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r3.claim: Al-Qushayrī says lineage may count in compatibility when it means connection to the Prophet’s family, scholars, or notable ascetics and righteous people; a pious believer outranks a wicked noble, but among equally pious people lineage can prevail, as youth over age in prayer when piety is equal.
QURTUBI-FULL:49:13#7/r3.anchor: قال القشيري أبو نصر: وقد يعتبر النسب في الكفاءة في النكاح وهو الاتصال بشجرة النبوة
